children: Company's installed annual manufacturing capacity reaches 3.12 lakh units following the opening of its fourth plant in Haryana

Zelio E-Mobility reported a 120.2 per cent year-on-year increase in consolidated revenue from operations to Rs 296.66 crore in the first half of FY27, compared with Rs 134.78 crore in the corresponding period last year. The electric two- and three-wheeler manufacturer also recorded a 164.3 per cent rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 31.39 crore, against Rs 11.87 crore in H1 FY26.

Profit before tax (PBT) increased 165.5 per cent to Rs 38.26 crore from Rs 14.41 crore in the year-ago period. Total revenue stood at Rs 299.76 crore during the six-month period, compared with Rs 135.77 crore a year earlier.
Earnings per share (EPS) also increased to Rs 14.84 in H1 FY27 from Rs 7.18 in the corresponding period last year, reflecting an improvement in the company's financial performance.

The unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the half year ended 30 September 2026 were approved by the company's board of directors on 13 November, following the recommendation of the audit committee.
Zelio E-Mobility has expanded its annual manufacturing capacity to 3.12 lakh units following the opening of its fourth manufacturing plant in Patan, Hisar, Haryana.

The company currently operates four manufacturing facilities in Ladwa, Cuttack, Coimbatore and Patan. The additional facility is expected to support its production capabilities as it expands its presence in India's electric mobility market.
Its dealer network has crossed 400 partners across more than 25 states and is moving towards a target of 550 dealers, according to the company.
